failure.mechanism: The OpenMP runtime pinned the main process thread to CPU 0 before the persistent std::thread team was created. All C++ workers inherited the one-CPU affinity mask.
failure.observed_process_affinity: twenty operating-system threads, each restricted to CPU 0
failure.impact: The commands requested twenty workers but the formal optimization runs used approximately one CPU core. The observations are excluded from formal quality and performance evidence.

repair.required_runtime_gate: Every formal run must observe at least the selected worker count and the union of full-team task affinities must equal the frozen selected CPU set.
repair.restart_policy: Regenerate the manifest after committing the launcher repair and restart every CPU-admissible run from an empty active result root.

claim_boundary: The archived files are diagnostic evidence only and must never be reused by Plan 005 formal admission or paper analysis.
